113362:
The Arena is a competitive mode where you battle other players to earn points and climb the rankings.

A total of three types of Arena rewards are available:

Arena Progression Rewards: Rewards granted upon battle completion.
Arena Weekly Participation Rewards: Rewards based on weekly participation count, reset weekly.
Season Ranking Rewards: Ranking rewards reset weekly.
Arena seasons last one week. The Arena resets every Monday at 00:00 (UTC 15:00).

Upon reset, your starting score is adjusted based on a portion of your previous week's score. Participation rewards are also reset, allowing you to earn them again. Each week's #1 ranked player's record will be permanently saved as an an all-time top record.

※ In Arena battles, if speeds are equal, the defending team attacks first.
113363:
Overlord Conquest involves large-scale battles against powerful boss armies.
 
 The enemy fields 3 units, while you can deploy up to 5 allied units.
 
 Winning units can engage the next enemy unit in successive battles.
 
 You can set the enemy unit's level, higher levels yield greater rewards.
 
 Overlord Conquest resets weekly, every Sunday at 00:00 (UTC 15:00).
 
 Upon reset, the enemy unit types change. Your rank is determined by the highest level achieved against those units, and rewards are distributed based on this rank at reset. Last week's #1 record is preserved as an all-time Overlord Conquest record.
113364:
The 3v3 Arena is a competitive mode where you directly swap ranks with other players through intense battles.

In the 3v3 Arena, you deploy 3 units to engage in combat. Battles proceed based on your deployment order. The first player to secure 2 wins claims victory.

Win a battle to immediately swap ranks with your opponent.

You'll earn Arena Coins per minute based on your current rank, accumulating up to a set maximum. Tap the reward box to collect your accumulated Arena Coins.

Players sets up and deploy 3 teams of 6 fighters (total 18 gals).

Summon System Overview:

Banner Types
- Normal Summon / Normal Hidden Piece Summon
  - Drawn from the normal hero pool
  - New characters are added here after the pickup banner ends

- Pickup Summon / Pickup Hidden Piece Summon
  - A banner that focuses on a specific character
  - Pickup characters will later join the normal summon pool

- Limited Summon / Limited Hidden Piece Summon
  - A time-limited banner that includes exclusive characters
  - Usually includes seasonal/theme units (Swimsuit, Christmas, Halloween) and 
    Light/Dark attribute units

- Special Summon / Special Hidden Piece Summon
  - Fixed lineup : Sayuri, Yuzuki, Sayo, Jass
  - Can only be obtained through that banner
  - A new hero is planned to be added after one rotation


Pity / Guarantee System
- Normal Summon
  - Guaranteed if no SSR+ character is obtained within 100 summons
  - Guaranteed if no SSR+ Hidden Piece is obtained within 80 summons
  - Count resets upon obtaining SSR+

- Pickup & Pickup (Limited) Summon
  - Uses a mileage system
  - Pickup SSR+ character guaranteed after 120 summons
  - Pickup Hidden Piece guaranteed after 100 summons
  - Mileage does not reset even if SSR+ is obtained early

- Special Summon / Special Hidden Piece Summon
  - Uses a mileage system
  - Pickup SSR+ character guaranteed after 120 summons
  - Pickup Hidden Piece guaranteed after 100 summons
  - Mileage does not reset even if SSR+ is obtained early


Duplicate System
- Character Duplicates
  - Obtain character shards and Hero Essence (used in the Hall of Heroes shop)
  - Max star characters are fully converted into Hero Essence

- Hidden Piece Duplicates
  - Automatically upgrades star level
  - If already at maximum, converted into Hidden Memory Puzzle Pieces (used in the Piece Shop)

"[Exchange Shop]
You can purchase items using the currency obtained within the game.

[Trade Shop Guide]
The shop gradually expands as the Contractor progresses through the stages.
Upon reaching specific stages, the variety of items increases, the lineup changes, and certain item quantities are expanded.
Therefore, the higher the stage, the more types of items and diverse compositions you will encounter.

Below are the expansion changes of the shop by stage sections.

Upon reaching Stage 3-1
The shop expands for the first time, increasing the number of items to five types.
Basic resources and essential items are newly displayed.

Upon reaching Stage 5-1
The number of item types remains at five, but some item lineups are renewed.
The configuration of items needed for early growth becomes more efficient.

Upon reaching Stage 7-1
The shop expands again, increasing the number of items to six types.
From this point, intermediate growth items appear additionally.

Upon reaching Stage 9-1
The number of item types remains at six, but some product compositions and quantities change.
New combinations of items can be purchased at lower prices.

Upon reaching Stage 11-1
The shop expands, increasing the number of item types to seven,
and premium resources or growth support items are added.

Upon reaching Stage 15-1
The shop undergoes a large-scale expansion, increasing the number of item types to eight.
You can now purchase rarer items with more options available.

Upon reaching Stages 19-1, 23-1, 27-1, and 31-1
The shop maintains its maximum expansion state.
The number of item types remains at eight, but product composition and quantities are partially changed at each step.
Since new items replace old ones, it is recommended to check the shop periodically.

Finally,
If you are lucky, you may obtain more valuable items at lower prices."

[Guild Raid Guide]

[ Event Overview ]

Guild Raid is cooperative content where you challenge a powerful boss together with your guild members.

When you clear a raid stage, you can obtain raid points,
and the obtained points are reflected in Guild Raid progress and Guild ranking.

Join forces with your guild members to defeat the boss and obtain various rewards.

[ How to Play ]

1. Challenge Raid Stages

* During the Guild Raid period, you can challenge raid stages a set number of times each day.
* Raid stages can only be participated in while you are in a Guild.

2. Obtain Raid Points

* When you clear a raid stage, you obtain raid points.
* The obtained raid points are reflected in Guild Raid progress.

3. Progress Increase and Boss Defeat

* When the raid points obtained by guild members accumulate, Guild Raid progress increases.
* When the progress reaches a certain value, the boss can be defeated.
* When the boss is defeated, you proceed to the next stage, and rewards can be obtained on the battle progress status page.

4. Guild Ranking Competition

* Rankings are determined based on the accumulated raid points by Guild.
* Guilds that achieve higher rankings can obtain more rewards.

[ Raid Story ]

When you obtain raid points, you can open the raid story.

Clear raid stages,
and check the special story that unfolds after the fierce battle.

[ H Image Guide ]

When you increase Guild Raid progress and defeat the boss,
the H image check button is activated.

Opened H images are saved in the album,
and can be viewed again afterward.


[ Notes ]
* Raid stage challenge counts are refreshed each day according to the set standard.
* Rewards can only be obtained when the conditions for each content are met.
* Guild rankings are determined based on the accumulated raid points by Guild.

In Ero Dorado, a costume system allows you to enjoy a variety of styles for each heroine.
Costumes can be obtained through the following methods:

■ Costume Shop
You can directly purchase costumes with various themes from the in-game shop.
Once purchased, the costume is applied to battles, illustrations, home screen, and more.
Some costumes are only available for a limited time or during specific seasons.

■ Rare Boutique
You can earn mileage through certain in-game activities.
Use this mileage to exchange for select costumes.

■ Costume Pass
A paid seasonal pass that provides special missions and rewards.
By completing pass missions, you can earn additional rewards on top of the standard ones.
An SSR-grade costume is granted at the final tier.
Pass costumes are only available during their respective season. Re-releases are currently undecided.

Collect new looks for your heroines through costumes,
and create a style that’s uniquely your own!
